title: Table diagram
canvas: Table diagram. Drag a card to move it, hold Space and drag to pan, scroll to zoom. With a card selected, arrow keys move it 16 px, Shift moves it 64 px.
collapsedNote: There are {count} tables, more than {limit}, so cards show only the table name to keep the diagram readable and fast. Lines connect to the whole card. Press "Show all columns" to see columns.
missingNote: {count, plural, one {# foreign key points to a table that is not in the list, so it has no line.} other {# foreign keys point to tables that are not in the list, so they have no lines.}}
fkMissing: Foreign key to {table}.{column}, which is not in the list
nodeLabel: Table {name}, {count, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}
summaryTitle: Summary of {count, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}}
summaryTable: Table {name} has {count, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}:
summaryRelations: {count, plural, one {# foreign key relation} other {# foreign key relations}}
summaryMissing: {from}.{column} references table {table}, which is not in the list
